description: Daily minimum, maximum and mean regional reference price (RRP, $/MWh) for one NEM region over a date range. Daily summary only: the raw 5-minute price series is not exposed (it is published by AEMO on NEMWEB). Use it for price context around revenue or events. For individual price spikes use list_events.

region.description: NEM region code: NSW1, QLD1, SA1 (South Australia), TAS1 or VIC1.

name: get_regional_prices
title: Regional daily price summary
